$comment: Model routing reference. Prefer subscription models over API-billed. Fallback chain: Gemini (sub) -> Codex (sub) -> OpenAI API -> Sonnet (API) -> Opus (API) -> Qwen 3.6 local -> Nemotron 3 Super local. API-key GPT-5.5 is not yet available (Apr 2026); the API-key fallback stays on 5.4.

main_chat.rationale: Fast, cheap, good for general conversation. Subscription via google-gemini-cli OAuth.

coding.rationale: Strong coding on subscription. 88.7% SWE-bench, 60% fewer hallucinations than 5.4. Use /model gpt-5.5 in Coding topic.

deep_research.rationale: Strong reasoning on subscription via Codex OAuth. 92.4% MMLU.

crons_lightweight.rationale: Lightweight checks. No need for frontier models.

crons_heavy.rationale: Memory synthesis and doc drift on subscription.

precision.rationale: Best-in-class reasoning; +13% on a 93-task coding benchmark vs Opus 4.6. API-billed at $5/$25 per MTok. Use only when Codex falls short.

local_fallback.rationale: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B MoE: ~3B active params per token for fast inference. Free, local Metal GPU. Released Apr 16 2026. No web tools allowed.

local_precision.rationale: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super: 120B hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE, 12B active. Higher-quality local option when latency is less critical. Verify exact Ollama tag after pull and pin explicit quant for reproducibility.
